sentences.text: No one appears on behalf of the applicants, however, learned A.G.A. for the State is present.

The present application has been filed with the following prayer:-
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble court may graciously be pleased to allow the present application and direct any independent agency to enquire the factum of death status of the alleged deceased by making physical inspection of the house of Suresh Kumar Yadav Son of Ramashankar Yadav Resident Shivsagar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 3 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60591197/
1 of village Gaura Parmanpur, Police Station Jigna, District Mirzapur, so that justice be done.
It is further prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to stay the further proceeding of Sessions Trial nos. 108 of 2010 (State Vs. Ram Lolarkh) and 143 of 2010 (State Vs. Shivsagar and others), arising out of Case Crime No.298/2009,
Under Section 498A, 304B, 201 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Oonj, District Bhadohi pending in the court of Additional District and Sessions Judge/ Fast Track Court (First), Women Harassment, Bhadohi during the pendency of present 482 application, so that justice be done, otherwise applicants shall suffer irreparable loss and injury."

entities.text: Ramashankar Yadav Resident Shivsagar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: court of Additional District and Sessions Judge/ Fast Track Court (First), Women Harassment, Bhadohi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned A.G.A. submits that the prayer made in the present application is totally misconceived,
accordingly the same may be dismissed.

After perusing the entire records as well as the prayer made in the present application, this Court agrees with the submission made by learned A.G.A. since after charge-sheet has been submitted the trial has commenced, any further investigation will linger on the trial proceedings and this Court cannot pass any order directing to conduct any enquiry or investigation by an independent agency as this Court has no power under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
The present application is accordingly, dismissed.
Order Date :- 3.1.2025
